en.william-c-chittick: The right of charity (sadaqa) is that you know it is a storing away with your Lord and a deposit for which you will have no need for witnesses.

If you deposit it in secret, you will be more confident of it than if you deposit it in public. [1] You should know that it repels afflictions and illnesses from you in this world and it will repel the Fire from you in the next world.
